profiles.limitations: Statistical CPU-timer samples are delivered to Python main-thread frames. Native-code and GIL/signal-delivery delays can bias attribution; snapshot-thread CPU can be charged to the interrupted main frame. Recursive/caller stacks overlap. Snapshot CPU and sampler CPU are included; no sampled share is an exact or wholly removable cost.

interpretation: Leaf shares count the interrupted Python location once per sample. Inclusive function shares count a function once per stack even under recursion; caller/child shares overlap and cannot be added. Sampling and serialization overhead and native-code signal delay remain; no sampled fraction establishes removable cost or native improvement. Per-rule denominators are retained; workers are not pooled into a timing claim.
